entities.name: Atlacan Huicintli
entities.description: Lord Steward, governor-in-exile of Atzocan, illegitimate son of Apatzec Intli II and majordomo of Emperor Apatzec Intli IV.

entities.name: Atzocan
entities.description: Sun Empire city-state Atlacan governs in exile.

entities.name: Apatzec Intli III
entities.description: Emperor, Atlacan's half-brother, who named him a paper son.

entities.name: Caztaca Huicintli
entities.description: Apex Priestess of the Threefold Sun, Atlacan's niece and adopted sister, who opposes him.

entities.name: Pachatupa
entities.description: City whose day-to-day Atlacan rules as the capital moves to Orazca.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: Target of a planned new invasion.

events.summary: Intli III's will names Atlacan a paper son, officially recognizing him in the dynasty though unable to inherit the throne.
events.quote: the emperor named Atlacan a "paper son," officially recognizing him as part of the Imperial dynasty

events.summary: Atlacan is charged with ruling Pachatupa day to day and drives plans for a new invasion of Torrezon, opposed by Caztaca.
events.quote: He is the main force behind the plans for a new invasion of Torrezon

relations.quote: is the uncle and majordomo of Emperor Apatzec Intli IV
he was the half-brother of Apatzec Intli III
finds opposition in his niece and adopted sister Caztaca Huicintli
